meta.note: The _CSS constant of the report renderer, read verbatim.

color.note: Names are the report's own CSS variables. Light is the default; dark follows prefers-color-scheme unless html[data-theme] pins one (the theme button toggles it).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background (body). Warm off-white, never pure white, so panels read as raised.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Card, tuner, button and pill fill. Sits on bg with a line border.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text: body, h1, codes, stat values, button labels. 16.6:1 on bg and panel in light, 14.9:1 in dark.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: h2, .sub, labels, .where, .detail, .score, table headers, empty state. 5.4:1 on panel in light, 6.0:1 in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every border and table rule, the trow divider, and the stripe of an incomparable row. Decorative: not held to a contrast floor.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one UI hue: range slider accent-color, button hover border, the selected lens button fill. 6.0:1 on panel in light.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on the selected lens button. The report hard-codes #fff: 6.0:1 on accent in light but only 2.2:1 in dark. Kept exact; see README, Known contrast gaps.

tokens.name: material
tokens.usage: Band 'material': the tag, its pill, its counts. Text on panel: 6.6:1 light, 7.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: review
tokens.usage: Band 'review': tag and pill. Same value as constraint. Text on panel: 5.5:1 light, 8.9:1 dark.

tokens.name: cosmetic
tokens.usage: Band 'cosmetic': tag and pill. Same value as muted, so the lowest band reads as quiet, not coloured.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Direction content_added and a '+' condition line. Text on panel: 5.3:1 light, 8.0:1 dark.

tokens.name: removed
tokens.usage: Direction content_removed and a '−' condition line. Same value as material: removal is the change most likely to matter.

tokens.name: upgraded
tokens.usage: Direction upgraded (availability moved up the lattice). Text on panel: 5.8:1 light, 7.5:1 dark.

tokens.name: decontented
tokens.usage: Direction decontented (availability moved down). Text on panel: 5.3:1 light, 7.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: package
tokens.usage: Directions package_shift and fulfillment_shift: the content is the same, the way it is fulfilled moved. Text on panel: 6.8:1 light, 6.6:1 dark.

tokens.name: constraint
tokens.usage: Direction constraint_only and a '~' reworded condition line. Same value as review.

tokens.name: incomparable
tokens.usage: Direction label of a trim present in only one model year. Deliberately faint: 2.8:1 on panel in light, 3.1:1 in dark. Kept exact; see README, Known contrast gaps.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: The system UI face at the sizes the report uses. Line height is 1.5 unless a style says otherwise. Uppercase styles say so in their usage; apply text-transform and letter-spacing together.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one h1. Old label, arrow, new label, then the noun.

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: h2. Uppercase, in muted, 32px above and 10px below. Introduces the appendix sections.

styles.name: subtitle
styles.usage: .sub under the title and the .empty state, in muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Availability and conditions are compared after resolving footnotes.
styles.usage: The body default. Little runs at this size; most text is one step smaller.

styles.name: description
styles.usage: .desc, the event's one-line description in the card header, in ink.

styles.name: detail
styles.usage: .detail, the optional paragraph under an event header, and details summary. In muted.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: The number in a stat, tabular-nums, in ink.

styles.name: control-label
styles.usage: label text and button labels in the tuner, and table.plain cells. Labels in muted, buttons in ink.

styles.name: pill-label
styles.usage: Band pills and table.matrix cells. A pill that is on goes to weight 600.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Stat labels (uppercase, this tracking) and, without tracking, .where and .cond lines.

styles.name: micro-label
styles.usage: Uppercase. The band tag (0.06em), direction labels and table headers (0.04em, plain th 0.05em).

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Anything a person might copy or compare column-wise: option codes, availability tokens, scores. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: code-ref
styles.usage: .code, the RPO option code in an event header.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: .score at the right of an event header, the tuner's output readouts, and .mono cells in the appendix tables. Two decimals, in muted.

styles.name: cell
styles.usage: .cell, the from → to availability pair in the trim matrix. nowrap.

styles.name: judgment-chip
styles.usage: .q, a question id, its raw score and confidence. In muted.

spacing.note: The report declares no scale; these are its literal paddings and gaps, named by where they apply. Keep them exact.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: .wrap max-width, centred.

tokens.name: page-gutter
tokens.usage: .wrap side padding at every width; also .ev and details horizontal padding.

tokens.name: page-top
tokens.usage: .wrap top padding, and the space above every h2.

tokens.name: page-bottom
tokens.usage: .wrap bottom padding, so the last card clears the viewport edge.

tokens.name: panel-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of .stats and .tuner; the gap between .trow controls.

tokens.name: panel-pad-y
tokens.usage: .tuner vertical padding.

tokens.name: stats-pad-y
tokens.usage: .stats vertical padding.

tokens.name: stats-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between stats; also .sub and .tuner bottom margin and .empty padding.

tokens.name: block-gap
tokens.usage: .stats bottom margin.

tokens.name: event-pad-y
tokens.usage: .ev vertical padding.

tokens.name: event-gap
tokens.usage: Space between event cards.

tokens.name: row-gap
tokens.usage: .trow + .trow: margin and padding either side of the divider.

tokens.name: header-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between header items in an event card; h2 bottom margin; details summary vertical padding.

tokens.name: control-gap
tokens.usage: Gap inside a .ctl and between band pills; the tuner's backdrop blur radius.

tokens.name: range-width
tokens.usage: Width of every range input.

tokens.name: button-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons and pills.

tokens.name: button-pad-y
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a button (a pill uses 4px).

tokens.name: tag-pad-x
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of a tag (vertical 2px).

tokens.name: cell-pad-x
tokens.usage: table.matrix cell padding (vertical 5px; th 4px).

tokens.name: plain-cell-pad-x
tokens.usage: table.plain cell padding (vertical 6px).

tokens.name: detail-gap
tokens.usage: .detail top margin.

tokens.name: matrix-gap
tokens.usage: table.matrix top margin under the event header.

tokens.name: scroll-margin
tokens.usage: .ev scroll-margin-top, so an anchored event lands under the sticky tuner.

radius.note: Four corners. Nothing is fully rounded except the pill.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every .card: stats, tuner, event, empty, details.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: The band tag.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Band pills.

shadow.note: One elevation. Cards carry a line border and this shadow; the shadow is relief, the border is the edge.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: .card. Nothing else casts a shadow.

opacity.note: Fading is how the report demotes what is present but not a finding.

tokens.name: opacity-unchanged-row
tokens.usage: tr.unchanged in the trim matrix: the trim is paired and identical.

tokens.name: opacity-unchanged-label
tokens.usage: .d-unchanged direction label, on top of muted.

tokens.name: opacity-pill-off
tokens.usage: A band pill that is not selected.

tokens.name: layer-tuner
tokens.usage: z-index of the sticky tuner, which blurs what scrolls under it.
